chunks.title: About Ataberk Estate
chunks.text: Ataberk Estate is a licensed real estate agency in Alanya, Turkey. The company has traded since 2005, 21 years as of 2026. It is a family business: Fatih Kabakçı is the Owner and CEO, and Aleksandra Kabakçı is the Owner and Executive Director. The Alanya office opened in 2014. The wider Ataberk Group employs around 150 people; the real estate division has more than 80. The group also includes Ataberk Yacht. Ataberk Estate is registered in the Turkish company register at the Alanya Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and takes full financial and legal responsibility for the legal cleanliness of the properties it offers. The company has completed roughly 6,000 transactions and holds about 30,000 properties on its books. Its main buyer markets are Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Iran, Germany and Turkey. Staff work across English, Russian, Polish and Turkish.

chunks.title: Why buying in Turkey pays
chunks.text: Four reasons Ataberk's buyers give for purchasing in Turkey. First, a sound investment: the climate, the coastline, the build quality and steady demand from foreign buyers keep Turkish property working as an investment rather than only a home. Second, every price bracket is available, from a modest studio or a well-priced resale through to a luxury villa. Third, payment on workable terms, instalments and Turkish bank credit are available. Fourth, residence: owning a home entitles the owner and their immediate family to apply for a Turkish residence permit.

chunks.title: What Ataberk does for buyers
chunks.text: Ataberk Estate provides full legal support for the transaction, help securing credit with a Turkish bank, and assistance settling into Turkey through its local offices. Services include online property tours, mortgage and credit assistance with Turkish banks, residence permit consultations, Turkish citizenship guidance, transfer and car rental, long-term and short-term rental, property management after purchase, legal transaction support, and translation. After-sales service continues after the deal closes: translation, paperwork, consultations and advice. Managers work individually with each client and respect confidentiality. If nothing on the site fits, they will source options directly.

chunks.title: Residence and citizenship
chunks.text: Owning property in Turkey entitles the owner and their immediate family to apply for a Turkish residence permit. Ataberk offers residence permit consultations and Turkish citizenship guidance as services. Some properties in the catalogue are marked as eligible for the citizenship route, for example listing 12504, a 4+1 duplex penthouse in Kargıcak, is listed as eligible for citizenship and residence. Ataberk advises discussing eligibility with a manager, as it depends on the property and the purchase value.

chunks.title: Instalments and payment
chunks.text: Instalment plans and Turkish bank credit are available on Ataberk properties. Several developer projects carry instalments directly: listing 12506 in central Mahmutlar offers instalments over 24 months, and listing 12505, a business centre in Oba, offers instalments up to two years. Ataberk also helps buyers obtain a loan from a Turkish bank. Terms depend on the property and the developer, a manager can confirm what applies to a specific listing.

chunks.title: How Turkish property sizes are described
chunks.text: Turkish listings describe layouts with a "X+1" notation. The first number is the count of bedrooms and the "+1" is the living room. So 1+1 is one bedroom plus a living room, 2+1 is two bedrooms plus a living room, and 4+1 is four bedrooms plus a living room. Ataberk's current homepage selection runs from 1+1 apartments of around 47 to 58 m² up to a 4+1 penthouse of 300 m². Areas are quoted in square metres.

chunks.title: Buying process and TAPU
chunks.text: Ataberk provides full legal support for the transaction. The Turkish title deed is called the TAPU. The company has staff dedicated to legal work, including a sworn interpreter and a TAPU lawyer, and describes long experience working with Turkish developers, banks and government agencies. Ataberk states it takes full financial and legal responsibility for the legal cleanliness of the properties it offers, and that it is registered with the Alanya Chamber of Commerce and Industry. Buyers are encouraged to ask about the purchase and registration procedure before committing to anything.

chunks.title: Languages
chunks.text: Ataberk's team works in English, Russian, Polish and Turkish. The company's About page states it works across 9 languages. Its websites exist in English (ataberkhomes.com), Russian (ataberkestate.com) and Polish (ataberkestate.pl). The business is Russian-first in origin and its main buyer markets are Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, Iran, Germany and Turkey.

chunks.title: Rental
chunks.text: Ataberk offers both long-term and short-term rental, and property management after purchase. There is a dedicated rental team: Vasiliy Potakhin heads rentals, with Olena Kharenko and Oleksandr Bunakalia. Owners who buy through Ataberk can have the property managed and let out. Ask a manager for current rental availability and terms, as the rental stock is not the same as the sales catalogue.
